claims.claim: Separate relation/public/private resources; sequential gates and explicit wire-lifetime management; exact input-stream consumption.
QED toolbox exposes ZKBackend methods for arithmetic, assert_zero, inputs, allocation, conversions and plugins.
ACIR distinguishes AssertZero, black boxes, fixed-length memory and unconstrained BrilligCall; ACVM solve statuses describe witness execution.
Brillig wraps integer arithmetic; ACIR field arithmetic and source checked integers are distinct; documented liveness reuse.
locators: Official Brillig documentation sections Bytecode and Arithmetic; capture text lines499-506

claims.claim: Typed named precomputation outputs are sequenced, topologically reordered and evaluated with shared term caching.
Constraint triples and precomputation terms are separate fields; PfDiv lowerer implements Incomplete mode and leaves other modes unimplemented.
Rebuild typed DAG, stable topological schedule, last-use row streaming and separate witness/constraint visitors in Sherlock/Clean.
